shortDescription: Manage the HPE Nimble Storage group

options.name: alarms
options.description: Whether alarm feature is enabled.

options.name: alert_from_email_addrs
options.description: From email address to use while sending emails. Case insensitive email address.

options.name: alert_min_level
options.description: Minimum level of alert to be notified.

options.name: alert_to_email_addrs
options.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to receive emails. Comma separated email list.

options.name: allow_analytics_gui
options.description: Specify whether to allow HPE Nimble Storage to use Google Analytics in the GUI. HPE Nimble Storage uses Google Analytics to gather data related to GUI usage. The data gathered is used to evaluate and improve the product.

options.name: allow_support_tunnel
options.description: Whether to allow support tunnel.

options.name: auto_switchover
options.description: Whether automatic switchover of Group management services feature is enabled.

options.name: autoclean_unmanaged_snapshots
options.description: Whether autoclean unmanaged snapshots feature is enabled.

options.name: autoclean_unmanaged_snapshots_ttl_unit
options.description: Unit for unmanaged snapshot time to live.

options.name: autosupport
options.description: Whether to send autosupport.

options.name: cc_mode
options.description: Enable or disable Common Criteria mode.

options.name: change_name
options.description: Change name of the existing group.

options.name: check_migrate
options.description: Check if the group Management Service can be migrated to the group Management Service backup array.

options.name: date
options.description: Unix epoch time local to the group. Seconds since last epoch. Example- 3400.

options.name: default_iscsi_target_scope
options.description: Newly created volumes are exported under iSCSI Group Target or iSCSI Volume Target.

options.name: default_volume_limit
options.description: Default limit for a volume space usage as a percentage of volume size. Volume will be taken offline/made non-writable on exceeding its limit. Percentage as integer from 0 to 100.

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: IP addresses for this group's dns servers.

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Domain name for this group. String of alphanumeric characters, valid range is from 2 to 255; Each label must be between 1 and 63 characters long; - and . are allowed after the first and before the last character.

options.name: fc_enabled
options.description: Whether FC is enabled on this group.

options.name: force
options.description: Can be used with halt or merge flag. Halt remaining arrays when one or more is unreachable. Ignore warnings and forcibly merge specified group with this group.

options.name: group_snapshot_ttl
options.description: Snapshot Time-to-live(TTL) configured at group level for automatic deletion of unmanaged snapshots. Value 0 indicates unlimited TTL.

options.name: group_target_enabled
options.description: Is group_target enabled on this group.

options.name: group_target_name
options.description: Iscsi target name for this group. String of up to 255 alphanumeric, hyphenated, colon, or period-separated characters; but cannot begin with hyphen, colon or period. This type is used for the group target name.

options.name: halt
options.description: Halt all arrays in the group.

options.name: host
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage IP address.

options.name: iscsi_enabled
options.description: Whether iSCSI is enabled on this group.

options.name: isns_enabled
options.description: Whether iSNS is enabled.

options.name: isns_port
options.description: Port number for iSNS Server. Positive integer value up to 65535 representing TCP/IP port.

options.name: isns_server
options.description: Hostname or IP Address of iSNS Server.

options.name: level
options.description: Level of the test alert.

options.name: login_banner_after_auth
options.description: Should the banner be displayed before the user credentials are prompted or after prompting the user credentials.

options.name: login_banner_message
options.description: The message for the login banner that is displayed during user login activity. String upto 2048 characters.

options.name: login_banner_reset
options.description: This will reset the banner to the version of the installed NOS. When login_banner_after_auth is specified, login_banner_reset can not be set to true.

options.name: merge
options.description: Perform group merge with the specified group.

options.name: migrate
options.description: Migrate the group Management Service to the current group Management Service backup array.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the group.

options.name: ntp_server
options.description: Either IP address or hostname of the NTP server for this group. Plain string.

options.name: password
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage password.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Password to authenticate with HTTP Proxy Server.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: Proxy Port of HTTP Proxy Server. Integer value between 0-65535 representing TCP/IP port.

options.name: proxy_server
options.description: Hostname or IP Address of HTTP Proxy Server. Setting this attribute to an empty string will unset all proxy settings.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Username to authenticate with HTTP Proxy Server. HTTP proxy server username, string up to 255 characters, special characters ([, ], `, ;, ampersand, tab, space, newline) are not allowed.

options.name: reboot
options.description: Reboot all arrays in the group.

options.name: repl_throttle_list
options.description: All the replication bandwidth limits on the system. All the throttles for the partner.

options.name: send_alert_to_support
options.description: Whether to send alert to Support.

options.name: skip_secondary_mgmt_ip
options.description: Skip check for secondary management IP address.

options.name: smtp_auth_enabled
options.description: Whether SMTP Server requires authentication.

options.name: smtp_auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate with SMTP Server.

options.name: smtp_auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate with SMTP Server.

options.name: smtp_encrypt_type
options.description: Level of encryption for SMTP.

options.name: smtp_port
options.description: Port number of SMTP Server.

options.name: snmp_community
options.description: Community string to be used with SNMP.

options.name: snmp_get_enabled
options.description: Whether to accept SNMP get commands.

options.name: snmp_get_port
options.description: Port number to which SNMP get requests should be sent.

options.name: snmp_sys_contact
options.description: Name of the SNMP administrator. Plain string.

options.name: snmp_sys_location
options.description: Location of the group. Plain string.

options.name: snmp_trap_enabled
options.description: Whether to enable SNMP traps.

options.name: snmp_trap_host
options.description: Hostname or IP Address to send SNMP traps.

options.name: snmp_trap_port
options.description: Port number of SNMP trap host.

options.name: src_group_ip
options.description: IP address of the source group.

options.name: src_group_name
options.description: Name of the source group.

options.name: src_passphrase
options.description: Source group encryption passphrase. Encryption passphrase. String with size from 8 to 64 printable characters.

options.name: src_password
options.description: Password of the source group.

options.name: src_username
options.description: Username of the source group.

options.name: state
options.description: The group operation.

options.name: syslogd_enabled
options.description: Is syslogd enabled on this system.

options.name: syslogd_port
options.description: Port number for syslogd server.

options.name: syslogd_server
options.description: Hostname of the syslogd server.

options.name: tdz_enabled
options.description: Is Target Driven Zoning (TDZ) enabled on this group.

options.name: tdz_prefix
options.description: Target Driven Zoning (TDZ) prefix for peer zones created by TDZ.

options.name: test_alert
options.description: Generate a test alert.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Timezone in which this group is located. Plain string.

options.name: tlsv1_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1.

options.name: user_inactivity_timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds that the user session is inactive before timing out. User inactivity timeout in second, valid range is from 1 to 43200.

options.name: username
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage user name.

options.name: validate_merge
options.description: Perform group merge validation.

options.name: vss_validation_timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to validate Microsoft VSS application synchronization before timing out. VSS validation timeout in second, valid range is from 1 to 3600.

options.name: vvol_enabled
options.description: Are vVol enabled on this group.
